messages:
anya: Quick pre-sync thread for Monday roadmap meeting. Need a decision on GPU mix, region order, and a phased rollout plan for Q4 capacity.

matt: Can we get a short list of constraints? vendor lead times, capex limits, and any hard customer migration dates.

sara: Vendor update: H100 lead times vary 20-28 weeks for new batch. A100/next-gen inventory available in 4-10 weeks at several partners. Also flag: some EU colos require 3-phase power upgrade with 8-12 week lead.

ravi: Utilization targets we discussed earlier: aim to reach 60-70% avg utilization within 30 days of new region hitting prod. But that assumes cross-region soft-routing for non-Dedicated traffic.

tom: Important: Dedicated tenant expectations. If we localize Dedicated to region-local hardware, first-wave utilization will be low. Recommend soft affinity + explicit migration windows for customers to opt into local region pinned capacity.

lee: Solutions team note: 3 enterprise customers asked for eu rollout in Nov, but two are flexible to Jan if we offer migration discounts. That gives us a small buffer.

matt: Finance: what's the PO approval threshold? We need to know if planned buys require exec signoff.

finance-bot: Reminder: CapEx bucket remaining for 2026: $6.8M. Any single vendor PO > $1.5M requires VP approval. Multi-quarter commit proposals subject to procurement review.

anya: So tradeoffs: faster expansion using A100s (short lead, lower perf) vs slower H100s (higher perf, higher TCO) vs hybrid staged approach. Also consider cloud-burst as short-term fallback.

ravi: Quick back-of-envelope:
```
Scenario A (All A100): faster launch, ~1.8x cards for same throughput, lower upfront cost but ops overhead until swap.
Scenario B (Hybrid): small H100 pool + A100 in new racks -> median cost but smoother perf.
Scenario C (Minimal HW + Cloud Burst): low capex, higher variable spend, good for uncertain demand.
```

sara: Also contractual risk: lead-time slippage on H100s historically ~+4 weeks on average when ordering >50 units.

matt: I will build a spreadsheet with: PO size, lead time, estimated time-to-prod, est. utilization ramp, expected monthly opex delta. Will include approval flag for PO > $1.5M. ETA Thursday.

tom: For routing policy: propose default soft-routing with cross-region fallback for non-sensitive Hosted API traffic, and strict regional pin for Dedicated unless a customer explicitly opts into cross-region fallback.

anya: OKR alignment: Link this plan to infra OKR — "Increase Serving region capacity while achieving average GPU utilization >= 60% within 30d and keep p50 latency for Hosted API < 120ms." We must ensure any capex plan doesn't break latency targets.

ravi: Add measurable rollout triggers: e.g., if utilization <45% after 30d, trigger traffic shift and promotional pricing for migrated customers. If H100 delay >12 weeks, activate cloud-burst autoscaling plan.

lee: Also add migration incentives timeline in the doc: 30-day opt-in windows with reduced migration fees for customers who move in first 60 days.

sara: I'll get updated quotes (unit price, warranty, lead time) for H100, A100, and potential PCIe variants by Wednesday. Also check local colo upgrade timelines and cost estimates.

matt: I will incorporate PO estimate column, break down into hardware PO, cabling/power upgrades, and staging labor. That should show which items push us over approval thresholds.

anya: Assign owners: Matt (scenario spreadsheet + PO estimates), Sara (vendor quotes + site upgrades), Ravi (OKR modeling + utilization runbook), Tom (routing/canary config + Dedicated policy), Lee (customer migration schedule). I'll assemble a decision matrix and recommended path by Friday EOD.

deploy-bot: INFRA-1133 created "Q4 capacity decision matrix" assigned to anya, matt, sara, ravi, tom, lee.

anya: Thanks team. Post updates to INFRA-1133 and drop sheet links here when ready. :thumbsup:
